newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index edges lower in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index edges lower in active trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed down 0.24 percent in active trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 504.01 from 505.23 on Monday.
Volume was 3.72 million dinars against 817,365 dinars. Turnover on the first market was 1.66 million dinars, and 1.98 million dinars in over-the-counter trade.
Banque Nationale Agricole bank declined 0.29 dinar to 31.5 dinars with 35,700 shares changing hands. Amen Bank edged 0.12 dinar lower to 36 dinars.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia fell 0.8 dinar to 49.2 dinars. Coke and beer bottler SFBT was down 0.5 dinar to 93.5. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF slid 0.5 dinar to 18.5 dinars.
BIAT bank advanced 1.8 dinars to 37.3 dinars. UBCI bank was up 0.8 dinar to 52.9. UIB bank rose 0.19 dinar to 13.02 dinars.
